name: minitui-monorepo
description: A terminal agent that builds small apps on demand and runs them behind a permission gate and an OS sandbox.

scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm run lint:policy-fixtures && pnpm run lint:test-policy && turbo run lint && pnpm run lint:trace && node scripts/check-action-pins.mjs && pnpm run lint:type-fixtures
scripts.pack:check: pnpm run build:all && node packages/types/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/sanitizer/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/transport/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/renderer-core/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/catalog/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/spec/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/renderer-ink/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs && node packages/runtime-host/scripts/pack-consumer.mjs
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm exec vitest run --project root
